Meta Test Description: This testcase verifies GPIO level-triggered interrupt functionality for all 32 GPIO pins (GPIO_8 to GPIO_39). It runs in two phases. Phase 1 (Active-High Level Interrupt): For each pin i (0 to 31) the test writes 0x00180000 to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4) which sets io_ctrl=1 (input mode) level_sel=1 (active high) and nedge_intr_en=1. Then writes (1<<i) to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1 (offset 0x84) to enable the group interrupt for that pin. Then writes 0xffffffff to SRAM address 0xA0243ffc to trigger the interrupt stimulus. The test waits in a while loop for int_pend to be cleared by the ISR. Phase 2 (Active-Low Level Interrupt): For each pin i the test writes 0x00100000 to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4) which sets io_ctrl=1 (input mode) level_sel=0 (active low). Then writes (1<<i) to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1. Then writes ~(1<<i) (inverted) to 0xA0243ffc. Waits for ISR. In the ISR (Default_IRQHandler): reads MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4) checks bit-1 (intr_raw_sts) is set. Reads MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1 (offset 0x88) and checks bit-i is set. Writes 0x00110000 to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4) to clear interrupt (intr_clr=1). Reads back and verifies value is 0x100001. Writes 0x00000000 to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1 to disable group interrupt. Reads MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1 and verifies it is 0x0. Writes to MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1 to clear sysreg interrupt status and reads back to verify cleared. Clears GIC IRQ. test_err is incremented on any failure. finish(test_err) is called at end.
Test Description: This test verifies that GPIO level-triggered interrupts work correctly for all 32 GPIO pins (GPIO_8 through GPIO_39) in both active-high and active-low configurations. The test then clears the interrupt at all three levels and verifies successful clearing. The test passes only if all 32 pins pass both active-high and active-low interrupt tests with zero errors.
